## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-07

### Added

- Measure loudness in-app with ReplayGain 2.0
- Add commit-message validator with a self-test
- Validate commit messages at commit time

### Changed

- Gui cover cache and frame widget; store adapter
- Shared store test support; folder-watch plumbing
